samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: Consider the proposal that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities. What are its advantages and disadvantages?
requirementsVi: Bàn cả lợi ích và bất lợi.
Mỗi mặt cần giải thích và ví dụ.
Tổng hợp, không tự đổi thành chỉ nêu ý kiến.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities could affect everyday life in several ways. It is useful to consider both the opportunities it creates and the difficulties it may bring. Neither side should be judged only from a slogan, because the practical details can make a substantial difference.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu nhiệm vụ so sánh hai mặt.

parts.labelVi: Giới thiệu đề xuất + mệnh đề

parts.text: teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities could affect everyday life in several ways. It is useful to consider both the opportunities it creates and the difficulties it may bring. Neither side should be judged only from a slogan, because the practical details can make a substantial difference.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can quickly access useful learning material. This is possible because a shared task can direct phone use towards a specific question rather than casual browsing. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that notifications can distract students. This matters because a device used for learning also gives access to games and private messages. For instance, a pupil may stop following a discussion after receiving several messages from friends. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that players can enjoy a hobby while still making time for other needs. This is possible because a planned routine can include games, study, movement and face-to-face contact. For example, a teenager can play with friends after finishing homework and still join a weekend football match. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cân bằng chơi game cần thỏa thuận thời gian thực tế và giữ trách nhiệm học, ngủ, vận động.

paragraphs.label: Bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits. This matters because parents and children may disagree about when an online match can reasonably be stopped. For instance, a parent may demand an immediate stop in the middle of a team game that was arranged in advance. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

paragraphs.label: Điều gì làm thay đổi tác động?
paragraphs.text: The balance between these effects depends partly on organisation. For example, families sometimes set limits without discussing how the activity works. A way to reduce this difficulty would be to agree on realistic finishing times and responsibilities before play begins. A family could decide on a final match and keep the same bedtime on school nights. This would not remove every disadvantage, but it could make the approach more suitable for a wider range of people.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, an important advantage is that players can enjoy a hobby while still making time for other needs, whereas a notable disadvantage is that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits. Both should be considered before a decision is made, with attention to the resources and circumstances of the people affected.
